newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Solarco delisted by Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Solarco delisted by Nasdaq.

text.p: The Nasdaq Stock Market said Tuesday it delisted shares of Alpha Solarco Inc after the market closed on November 11, for not satisfying the minimum total assets requirement, and for not meeting the capital and surplus requirement.
The company was not immediately available for comment.

Alpha Solarco, an energy company involved in developing new technologies for solar energy, was recently identified in a U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigations sting operation involving payment to brokers in exchange for recommending certain securities to customers, the exchange said.

The Arizona-based company was also delisted from Nasdaq to protect prospective investors and the public interest, the exchange said. Its closing bid price on November 11 was $0.19 per share, Nasdaq said.
